notes.title: UPDATE #8 - THE GAME IS OUT!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27690305/4e11f172483ac952f67e5733f08b976ac0a52822.png

Hi, everyone!

We're glad to announce Light Apprentice is now fully released on Steam!

It was a really tough journey, but we hope Nate, Tlob and the rest of the crew will now be able to reach more hearts than ever before. The market is really crowded with so many great games coming out per day, but hey, Steam is still a really big deal!!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27690305/b7081df521bff60db48c49105fe5db4f68b16674.png

We're proud to have made it so far, but please bear in mind it's only the start. Meaning there's plenty of room on this bandwagon! Though we're itching to jump into the production of Volume 2, we think it best to stay on a hold for a little while and give support to the new Volume 1 players who might have any issues during their experience. The game is finished, we tested it thoroughly, but unexpected effects may still happen, plus small bugs and glitches are to be expected even in big productions.

We want to give a big shoutout to the amazing community who has supported us, including the dozens of streamers and lets players, who tagged along for the journey since Light Apprentice popped up on Early access in March this year. You're amazutastic!!! Without your help, we wouldn't have made it this far!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27690305/c0769caeeddb12827f30598a607763cb8fe6c76b.png

But Light Apprentice hopes to become much stronger with your support. Please, take a moment to share the news that Light Apprentice is out to your friends in real life, on social media, and keep an eye for some really exciting news from us just around the corner.

When I started this project many years ago, I would have never imagined we would come this far. But here we are!

Thank you all once again, enjoy the game, take care, and don't forget to...

SHINE YOUR LIGHT!!!

@iggynore

PS: For the Early Access players who are experiencing bugs or severe problems, specially related to your save, we urge you to start a new one. We worked a lot behind the scenes on the save system (basically revamped it) so it's a really good idea to start a new save file in case you're having weird problems. This will avoid many headaches. Merci!

notes.title: UPDATE #7 - Contest rules update + ends tomorrow!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27690305/8f2ae91b0c600361e5fd037d813b46a8a5f11fd9.jpg

Hi, everyone!

We're making the rules of the content more obvious and clear to everyone!

Since the game is practically finished now, we have received messages saying there are practically not many bugs to be found, so the main rule of the contest (how to win) takes on a different meaning.

Since before the rules said the "most useful bug report wins", we're now changing it to "you need to play the game from start to finish this week", and comment on the forum you want to participate in the contest -> http://steamcommunity.com/app/569570/discussions/0/1483235412200423826/

Also, we have extended the deadline til tomorrow, since so many of you only heard about this contest so late (our fault! We been busy).

Much simpler eh? We'll look into your steam profile to see how many hours you played this week to see if you're eligible to the prize, which will be decided by random. Let me know if you have any questions.

A new build version has been uploaded in the BETA branch (right click the game in the library, select properties, go to the beta tab and select beta in the drop down menu), which means you should try on the new features:
- Buff icon countdown was implemented, now you can check how long you have until the buff lasts (the only one missing now is Stunned, coming in an update)
- Buffs continue from challenge to challenge in Quest mode. Now Quests are more dynamic and strategic!
- General bug fixes

Thank you all for reporting bugs and other problems to us! There are still a very few improvements that will come in an update. But the game should be pretty much done now.

However! If you play the game and you STILL find bugs or undesired effects, please let us know, it is still very important to find bugs if they're laying around. We would be delighted to help and provide a better experience to everyone who plays the game.

See you on the launch update! Until then, don't forget to...

SHINE YOUR LIGHT!

- iggynore

REVIEW

Have a great week, everyone!

notes.title: Update #1 - Steam cards
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27690305/9791e82cc16ba9fc0a143119b693f72d98374824.png

Hi, everyone!
Here's the first update of Light Apprentice!

Update notes
- Fixed the bug in which your potions would not be saved after a challenge (battle)
- Rebalancing and new levels of difficulty: Normal and Hard (the previous only level has become the Easy one). We hope you'll enjoy each of them!
- Mouse wheel/up on controller to scroll up, in case you missed any immediate comic part(s)
- Adventure mode cursor easier to navigate with controller
- Sometimes he game would break later on your second save. Not anymore
- Various bug fixes and graphic improvements in chapters 2, 3 and 4

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27690305/1c0101754e213f6105e7a242f172415cb4648dd6.png

Early Access
We like Early Access because it allows us to develop with the community. Thanks to you, we were able to i.e. identify the biggest bug on the list (potions not being saved if you die in a challenge), and I hope it will make it better for you. We also made the Quests button more obvious, so you'll hopefully click there and understand that's where you can get more potions if you run out of them. There was much more fixed, but I'm trying to keep it short :)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27690305/46b8935307490876791ec2618ff278701e17c945.png
Fanart by Egg

We hear you, but...
With that being said, I have heard a few of you and feel obliged to tell you that there is still no auto save or save wherever you want feature, and there probably won't be one. The current save system is a design choice, and until we are able to change the core system of the game (it would take a lot of time and resources and would extrapolate out budget and time frame), it can't be changed. But we can insert more checkpoints if it would make it better. Regardless, I'd like to say a big thank you to the community for the support so far, with your fanarts, your screenshots, comments, and specially for sharing it with your friends.
